column4: The 'conference' sense is dubious and obscure and overlaps with the other collation senses, so it only confuses a learner.
The vague gloss 'concerning other artistic' is meaningless and duplicates the main sense of compositorisch (relating to composing).
Archaic pharmaceutical sense 'electuary' is obscure and only confuses a learner; it is not a true duplicate but should go.
This duplicates the other meaning 'confession' (admission of wrongdoing/sins), so it is redundant.
'Comrade' is a misleading gloss and duplicates the meanings 'confrere' and 'fellow member'.
'Quality of being congruent' only restates 'congruence' from meaning 3.
Syzygy is an obscure astronomical sense; 'conjunction' is the meaning a learner needs and is already listed.
Neoplasticism is an archaic and obscure equation with constructivism (it is really De Stijl), and it would only confuse learners.
jointer is not a meaning of dagge; the word is a rare/archaic dagger and the other meaning already covers it.
Dagwijzer is an obscure word whose sense duplicates the calendar meaning, so it only confuses a learner.
Member of the ancient Dalmati tribe is obscure and largely overlaps with inhabitant of Dalmatia, so it only confuses a learner.
Ultimate sacrifice is not a meaning of dameoffer, which is a chess queen sacrifice, already listed as the other meaning.
It merely restates item 1 as 'something that causes disappointment', so it duplicates the first meaning.
'Declension (act of declining)' duplicates the declension meaning in item 4.
'Sad' is too close to the corrected meaning of the other entry and is a weaker sense; it duplicates the pitiful/grievous meaning.
'Meagre' is not a real meaning of deerniswekkend; it only means pitiful, which is listed separately.
Deklat means a cover strip (batten), so 'crossbar' duplicates the other meaning.
'Proposal' is too close to the other meaning and doesn't fit; denkpiste means a line of thought, so this duplicates the first.
'Goop' is a loose, vague duplicate of the more precise meaning 'peat contaminated with clay' (derrie is a type of soft peat/sludge).
Archaic, obscure word whose gloss 'individual' is unreliable and unhelpful to a learner; the other listed meaning 'depth' is also unrelated, so this entry only confuses.
'In favor of' is not a meaning of Diets, which is an archaic word for Dutch, so this sense is wrong.
Diets as 'Middle Dutch' is an obscure historical term, and 'Dutch' is already listed as another meaning, so this entry only confuses a learner.
Discobolus is just another word for discus thrower, which is already listed as another meaning, so this duplicates it.
Female doctorandus and female doctorand are effectively the same meaning, so this one duplicates the other.
To feather is not a real meaning of doezelen; the sense is to doze or to shade/blur, so this is wrong and obscure.
Dommelen means to doze; 'to buzz' is not a real meaning of this word.
Dommelen does not mean 'to thump'; only 'to doze' is correct.
Doodlopen is not used for exhausting oneself by running; that is a doubtful invented meaning.
Outsailing another ship is not a real meaning of doodlopen and would only confuse a learner.
'Dead-colouring' is not a real meaning; doodverven means to predestine, which is already listed, so this is an obscure duplicate.
'Chrisom' is an obscure archaic English term for the same object as 'christening robe', so it duplicates the other meaning.
'Medium' duplicates the figurative 'mere conduit' meaning and is not a distinct sense.
Duplicate of the other doorkerven entry with the same gloss, so it only confuses.
'To continue carving' is the separable doorkerven sense, which is rare and not a distinct lookup meaning; the 'carve through' entry covers it.
Doorkijken does not mean 'to continue watching' (that is doorkijken only loosely, not standard); the real meanings are to look through and to skim through.
'Transmissive' duplicates the permeable meaning, since doorlatend just means letting something through.
It duplicates the 'continue studying' meaning with a poor gloss.
It is a near-duplicate of the literal puncture meaning and of the multiple-punctures meaning, and adds nothing for a learner.
Putting numerous punctures into something is covered by the literal puncture meaning, so it is a duplicate.
To continue shoving is a literal sense that overlaps with "to move" (pass along) and adds little.
'To be connected' is not a meaning of doorweven; the real senses (interweave, weave through) are already covered.
Archaic term for Mennonite that duplicates the Anabaptist meaning and only confuses a learner.
Archaic and obscure early Christian cemetery sense would only confuse a learner.
'Yield load' is an obscure, dubious technical sense that is not a separate everyday meaning of draaglast, so it only confuses learners.
'Planar support' is a vague, jargon-like repeat of the general 'support' meaning and confuses a learner.
A DJ controller is not what draaitafel means; turntable and record player already cover it.
It is a rare near-duplicate of the temperance movement sense, which is the same concept of fighting alcohol abuse.
'To make vibrate' is not a real meaning of drillen and is obscure or incorrect.
To operate a pneumatic drill duplicates the existing "to drill" meaning.
The archaic 'grapeshot' sense is obscure and the cluster-of-grapes meaning is the real one learners need.
'Press wheel' duplicates the printing roller meaning, which is the better-known sense of drukrol.
large is a near-repeat of "considerable" for duchtig, which really means considerable or sizeable.
powerful is a rare nuance that overlaps with the other glosses and only confuses learners.
A place-derived adjective for Duffel is obscure and the meaning made from duffel cloth is the common one, so drop this one.
'duney' merely repeats the other meaning 'dunelike'; one entry is enough.
'Very thin' is not a meaning of the noun dundoek; it is an invented meaning.
Duplicates the 'size of paper' meaning; duodecimo is one concept (the format and a page of it).
Zealous is essentially the same meaning as excessively adoring, so it duplicates item 1.
Female homewrecker is essentially a duplicate of the other meaning "female adulterer" for echtbreekster, which is the better gloss.
Homewrecker duplicates the other meaning "adulterer", which is the accurate translation of echtbreker.
Consisting of one person is not a real meaning of eenkoppig; it only means one-headed (e.g. a single-headed organization), so it is a dubious duplicate of the other sense.
The 'respect' meaning is essentially a duplicate of the venerability sense, which is the same quality of being worthy of respect.
'Edge' is not a real meaning of egge and it would duplicate a non-existent sense; the harrow meaning is kept in another entry.
'Skewed' is an adjective sense that egge as a noun does not have, so this meaning does not exist.
'Quick' is not a meaning of ejaculatie (it is a mistaken gloss from the Latin root) and the sense duplicates nothing real.
'Affectionate' is not a meaning of engelin, and the real meaning, female angel, is already listed.
Anglican is not a general sense of episcopaal; it is a narrow, confusing sense covered by episcopal.
Point of honor duplicates the other meaning, matter of honor.
'Ultimate' is not a noun meaning of extremiteit and is covered by the other senses (extremity, extreme peril).
'Ass' is a wrong, imprecise gloss that duplicates the foal-of-a-donkey meaning.
Fanciful and imaginative are near-synonyms for the same meaning, so this duplicates item 3.
The gloss about teeth is nonsense for fietsenrek, and the real meaning (bicycle stand) is already listed as another meaning.
It duplicates item 3, since sensitiveness and delicacy are essentially the same meaning.
'Political power' is not a meaning of filibuster; it is wrong and obscure.
Inflection and flexion (bending) are essentially the same word sense, so this duplicates the other meaning.
gallisch does not mean hot; it means bilious or furious, so this meaning does not exist and the other entries cover the real senses.
Ganzerik meaning gander is a rare variant of 'gent' (ganzerik is also used for gander in dictionaries), but it is obscure and confusing, so the plant meaning is enough.
Garf does not mean rent; it only means sheaf, so this meaning does not exist.
Duplicates the other gaslaag meaning; one entry covers it.
'Fast-fingered' is an adjective, not a noun meaning, and it duplicates the thief meaning.
tied-up is not a meaning of the abbreviation "geb.", which stands for "geboren" and sometimes "gebonden" (bound, as in book binding), so this is an obscure and misleading gloss.
Thumping duplicates throbbing, which is kept as item 1.
chimeric is a poor, obscure sense of an archaic word whose real meanings (monstrous, misshapen) are already listed, so it only confuses learners.
gedulden does not mean "to allow" (that would be dulden); the real meaning, to be patient or endure, is covered by the other entry.
Repeated is essentially the same sense as the other listed meaning "continuous" for gedurig, so it duplicates it.

column3: with a yellow and a green colour
column4: The gloss "with a yellow and a green colour" duplicates the other meaning "yellow-green", which is more concise.
'Shade' is a vague duplicate of the colour meaning already listed.
'Dubious business' is not a real meaning of geflikflooi; the word only means flattery, which is covered by the other entry.
The 'underhanded person' meaning for geheimschrijver is not a real informal usage and appears invented.
'Auditory' is not a noun meaning of gehoorzaal and is a bad duplicate of the same sense.
Duplicates the other geitenpad meaning, which is now glossed as a narrow path.
The art-term 'carnation' sense is obscure and the example is ungrammatical and misleading; it is essentially the same as complexion.
'Money tap' is the literal rendering of the same idiom already covered by the other meaning, so it is a duplicate.
'gelieven' means 'to be pleased to / to deign'; 'to enjoy' is not a real meaning and duplicates the other entry.
Duplicates 'to display the same time'; a clock that runs correctly is essentially the same meaning.
'Concurrent' is not what gelijkluidend means; it means identically sounding or worded, already covered by homophonous.
'Homophonic' duplicates 'homophonous', which is the same meaning, so one entry suffices.
'To harmonize' is a figurative repeat of tuning to the same pitch, so it is a duplicate of the other meaning.
Gemeenzaamheid means familiarity or intimacy; 'colloquialism' is not a real meaning and the other sense already covers it.
Gereed does not mean reasonable; this meaning does not exist.
